decision: Authorize exactly one file beyond the W05 write scope of src/epistemic_foundry/recovery/v4_w05/**: the package marker src/epistemic_foundry/recovery/__init__.py. It contains a docstring only and declares no vocabulary, no API and no behaviour. This mirrors HD-EF4-E05-SCOPE-20260802-001, HD-EF4-F05-SCOPE-20260802-001 and HD-EF4-M05-SCOPE-20260802-001 and authorizes nothing beyond the single marker. W05 otherwise writes only under its granted scope and artifacts/work_packages/W05/**, reads its vocabularies from canonical schemas, manifests and declaring modules, and holds no canonical schema enum value as a string literal.
rationale: pyproject.toml discovers packages with setuptools find_packages (where = ['src']), which requires __init__.py at every level; verified empirically under HD-EF4-E05-SCOPE-20260802-001 that without the marker the nested package imports from a checkout but is absent from the built wheel — the source/dist divergence the sealed B04 build gate exists to prevent. Changing the discovery mode in pyproject remains rejected: pyproject is B04's sealed territory. The W05 attempt (evolution checkpoint/resume/cancel and drift reassessment) carries a packaging-discovery check proving the package stays discoverable.
